dedupe_keys.name: input data for the simulation of water supply system of athens

description: Georgia Konstantina Sakki and Andreas Efstratiadis at the National Technical University of Athens publish inputs for simulating the Athens water-supply system. The description lists stochastic water-demand, rainfall, evaporation, runoff and electricity-price series, together with system characteristics and operating rules. The April 2023 Zenodo inventory contains Price_Burr.csv, reservoirs_data.xlsx and demands.xlsx, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. The public metadata leave the simulation horizon, time interval, units and exact mapping of every described variable to workbook sheets unknown. These inputs could support water-allocation and pumping-cost simulations for the Athens system. The stochastic series should be treated as model inputs, not measured operating histories. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified, and no spreadsheet or CSV contents were inspected. Reuse requires checking the supplied schema and scenario definitions.
